updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access Integration (General Availability)
updates.summary: Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce data protection at the network layer across browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This allows admins to prevent sensitive data sharing with untrusted cloud apps and correlate risky user activity through Insider Risk Management without relying solely on endpoint or application-level controls.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Expanded Diagnostics Access to Compliance and Security Administrators
updates.summary: Access to Purview Diagnostics has been expanded beyond Global Admin to include Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator, and Organization Management roles. This delegation enables broader support teams to troubleshoot compliance and data governance issues without requiring global admin privileges.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management: Collection Policies Support
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview now supports collection policies within Insider Risk Management, allowing admins to scope Sensitive Information Types and activities to specific users for more targeted risk detection. Admins should review existing collection policies to ensure they align with their IRM policy requirements for detecting necessary activities.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management: Data Security Investigations Integration
updates.summary: Admins can now launch pre-scoped Data Security Investigations directly from an IRM case to perform deeper analysis of risky users and assess post-incident data impact. This integration streamlines workflows for security and compliance teams responding to insider risk incidents.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Upgraded Inline Protection for Microsoft Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP inline protection for Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business now integrates with Conditional Access grant controls and offers expanded policy conditions, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, and activity explorer visibility. This upgrade simplifies configuration and reduces policy restrictions while maintaining consistent data protection.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Expanded Inline Protection for Unmanaged Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP now extends browser inline protection to a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI apps in Edge for Business, allowing admins to detect and protect sensitive data shared through these applications using standard Purview policies. This expands consistent data security controls across more destinations without requiring separate policy frameworks.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: User-Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
updates.summary: DLP alerts can now be aggregated based on common user entities across multiple matched rules, consolidating related events into a single alert object. This reduces alert fatigue, simplifies investigation workflows, and provides better contextual understanding of policy violations for security teams.

updates.title: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Pre-Curated File Extension List for Policy Conditions
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now provides a pre-curated list of supported file extensions for policy conditions instead of free-form text entry, reducing the risk of unsupported extensions causing protection gaps and unnecessary endpoint processing. This improves policy reliability and endpoint performance by limiting extensions to those the system can actually scan.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: Purview now provides a single unified interface to discover, create, validate, and manage all classifiers—including Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers. This consolidation simplifies classifier administration and reduces the need to navigate multiple management surfaces.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention Policies
updates.summary: Admins can now configure Purview Data Lifecycle Management policies to archive inactive SharePoint files to low-cost storage in addition to keeping or deleting data, enabling comprehensive lifecycle governance. Archived files remain discoverable and compliant while reducing storage costs.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Insights and Policy Recommendations for Sensitive M365 Data
updates.summary: Purview now provides insights on sensitive data stored in OneDrive and SharePoint along with recommendations for retention policies, helping admins improve their data security and compliance posture. These recommendations enable data-driven decisions about which content requires specific governance controls.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Legacy Teams Retention Policies Will No Longer Govern Copilot
updates.summary: Existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams will be converted to Teams-only policies and will no longer implicitly apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. Admins should review and update retention policies if they intend to govern Copilot workloads separately.

updates.title: CVE-2026-77903: Microsoft Dataverse Authentication Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Dataverse allows unauthorized attackers to spoof identity and elevate privileges over a network. Admins should apply available security updates immediately to affected Dataverse instances.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69843: Microsoft Fabric Authentication Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Fabric allows unauthorized attackers to spoof identity and elevate privileges over a network. Organizations using Fabric for analytics and data engineering should apply patches to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive data and compute resources.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69865: Microsoft Container Registry Authorization Bypass Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authorization bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Container Registry allows unauthorized attackers to use user-controlled keys to elevate privileges over a network. Container registry admins should patch affected systems to prevent unauthorized access to container images and configurations.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85889: Azure AI Foundry Missing Authentication Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: A missing authentication vulnerability in Azure AI Foundry for a critical function allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Organizations leveraging Azure AI Foundry should patch immediately to prevent unauthorized model access and data exposure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-68791: Azure Machine Learning Incorrect Authorization Information Disclosure
updates.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Azure Machine Learning allows unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over a network. Teams running ML workloads should apply patches to prevent exposure of training data, model artifacts, and experiment details.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85878: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Improper Authorization Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An improper authorization flaw in Azure Database for PostgreSQL allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Database admins should apply patches to prevent privilege escalation attacks from legitimate users.
